scope: Same-event CE + ET-D inference: CE from 5 Hz and three ET channels from 2 Hz.
notes: Gaussian noise seed 2 and sampler seed 2 are shared across the three retained network runs.
The adaptive run used four H200 GPUs. Historical comparators used four H100 GPUs.
The matched fixed-grid H200 trial timed out. There is no completed paired speed ratio.
The adaptive result has three finite native likelihood checks. These do not qualify the posterior.
Historical 1024-bin attempts 5 and 8 share their physical parameter trajectory. They are not independent runs.
Saved configurations and source records retain their original external paths and options.

storage_policy.npz: Lossless ZIP compression; index.json records source, archive, and member hashes.

timing.loop: Nested sampling loop, excluding measured compilation.
timing.finalise: Final live-point processing after the loop.
timing.sample_call: Observed call wall time, including first-use compilation.
timing.pipeline: Observed heterodyning start to synchronized sampler return; blank if not measured.
timing.warm_pipeline: Not measured. Loop time alone does not establish event latency.
